title: Send Your Application
description: Email your resume and a short note about why you want to work at Websoftera. No cover letter template required — just be direct.

title: Quick Screening Call
description: A 20-minute call with our team lead to understand your background, skills, and what you're looking for.

title: Technical or Task Review
description: A practical task related to the role — not a whiteboard puzzle. We want to see how you actually work.

title: Final Conversation & Offer
description: A final conversation, then an offer — with a clear onboarding plan so your first week is productive, not confusing.
